sceneDescription: On a well-lit wooden kitchen counter, a shiny gold watch sits perched atop a classic glass cookie jar, with a stack of credit cards awkwardly wedged underneath the jar as if trying to prop it up. Next to the jar, a sleek, modern speaker shaped like a chatbot head is stuffed with ordinary paper receipts spilling out, and a tiny shopping bag bearing subtle Digital Commerce 360 and Jeweller logos peeks from behind the jar. The absurdity comes from luxury (the gold watch) and tech (chatbot speaker) being used as mundane supports for a cookie jar — a literal metaphor for 'protecting' value and the mixed effectiveness of AI in commerce.
